fee_notes: Tiered royalty structure: 19.25% of Gross Revenue for Non-Specialty Therapies and other products/services; 10.25% for Specialty Therapies; 3.25% for Select Specialty Therapies; 1.75% for Access Therapies. Additional Increased Royalty Fee of 0%-2% if TTM Gross Revenue exceeds $10M. Marketing Fee currently not collected but may be up to 1% of Gross Revenue. Technology Fee currently not collected but may be up to 0.5% of Gross Revenue. Pharmacy Software Fee: $1,500/mo for first Center, $750/mo each additional Center. Cyber-Security Software Fee: $500-$1,500 annually.
raw_excerpt: Royalty Fees: 19.25% of Gross Revenue related to Non-Specialty Therapies; 10.25% Specialty Therapies; 3.25% Select Specialty Therapies; 1.75% Access Therapies; 19.25% any other products or services. Marketing Fee: currently not collected, may collect up to 1% of Gross Revenue.
